description: This is a makefile fragment used in the OpenWrt build system. It defines variables, functions, and rules related to managing feeds, package directories, and package files (such as .ipk and .apk). It also contains macros for handling feed sources and package directory paths.

methods.name: FeedPackageDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for a specific feed package, considering per-feed repository configuration.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendOPKG
methods.description: Appends source definitions for opkg packages to a specified file, based on current configuration and available feeds.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendAPK
methods.description: Appends source definitions for apk packages to a specified file, based on current configuration and available feeds.

methods.name: GetABISuffix
methods.description: Retrieves the ABI suffix for a package, either from predefined variables or by formatting version info.

methods.name: FormatABISuffix
methods.description: Formats an ABI suffix based on package name and version information.
